turns.query: Across the legal-entity rows in the Federal Reserve's 2025 Supervisory Severely Adverse stress-test results, excluding the published participating-bank aggregate, match RSSD identifiers to 2024-12-31 Y-9C respondents with reported consolidated total equity. For every matched entity, scale the Fed projected total-loan-loss amount and projected provision amount by that same-date Y-9C equity. Report the matched count, summed Y-9C equity, summed projected loan losses, their ratio-of-sums, and the simple mean of the entity-level loan-loss-to-equity ratios. Separately identify the highest loan-loss-to-equity entity and the highest provision-to-equity entity, resolving an exact tie by Fed disclosure legal name alphabetically. For each leader report its Fed legal name, RSSD identifier, Y-9C equity, relevant projected amount and scaled ratio, plus actual and projected-minimum CET1 ratios. Explain what the weighting and the two leader results show and how these scale ratios relate to the reported CET1 outcomes.
